settings.title: ⚙ Settings
settings.regroup_confirm:
Re-group all flights?

This will delete all automatically-created trips and rebuild them from scratch. Any notes, ratings, or edits you made on auto-generated trips will be lost. Manually created trips and flights are not affected.
settings.full_sync_confirm:
Run a full sync?

This will re-fetch all emails from the beginning of your sync window. It may take several minutes depending on how many emails you have. Existing flights won't be deleted.
settings.full_sync_ok: Full sync started! Fetching all emails…
settings.password_hint: For Gmail, generate an App Password at: Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords.
settings.smtp_desc: Run a simple SMTP server so users can forward flight confirmation emails directly to this app.
settings.smtp_domain_hint: Users without a custom forwarding address will default to username@domain.
settings.sync_interval_hint: How often the server polls email for new messages. Takes effect after restart.
settings.max_emails_hint: Maximum number of emails to fetch in a single sync run.
settings.first_sync_days_hint: How far back to look when syncing for the first time.
settings.smtp_port_hint: Use 2525 (or any port above 1024) to avoid needing root. Map port 25 → 2525 in Docker or your firewall.
settings.forwarding_desc: Forward flight confirmation emails to your personal address below. Each user has their own forwarding address.
settings.your_address_hint: Emails sent to this address will be processed and assigned to your account.
settings.allowed_senders_hint: Comma-separated list of email addresses allowed to forward to you. Leave blank to accept from anyone.
settings.airports_unranked: {n} airports are missing their size ranking, so airport names in emails may resolve to the wrong airport (a flight from “London” can become London, Ontario). Put an up-to-date airports.csv in data/ and reload.
settings.airports_download: Download airports.csv from ourairports.com and place it in the data/ directory.
settings.2fa_enabled_msg: Two-factor authentication is enabled on your account.
settings.2fa_disable_hint: Enter your TOTP code or current password to disable 2FA:
settings.2fa_setup_hint: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy), then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
settings.2fa_idle_hint: Add an extra layer of security to your account with an authenticator app.
settings.notif_unsupported: Push notifications are not supported in this browser.
settings.notif_denied: Notifications are blocked by your browser. Reset the permission in your browser settings to enable them.
settings.notif_desc: Get push notifications for upcoming flights, check-in reminders, and trip start alerts.
settings.notif_trip_reminder: Trip reminder (1 day before trip starts)
settings.notif_delay_alert: Delay & cancellation alerts (when departure is delayed ≥15 min or cancelled)
settings.notif_boarding_pass: Boarding pass ready (when a boarding pass is automatically added to a flight)
settings.notif_not_configured: Push notifications are not configured on this server yet
settings.notif_permission_error: Could not enable notifications — check browser permissions
settings.notif_new_flight: New flights found (when new flights are added from your emails)
settings.push_not_ready: VAPID keys not yet generated — restart the server to auto-generate them
settings.blocked_domains_desc: Emails from these domains are silently ignored during sync. Useful for accommodation, car rental, or other non-flight senders.
settings.integrations_desc: These are all optional — Partiu works without them. Each one adds a feature, and this shows what is missing without it. Set them in the server's .env file and restart.
integrations.carto_set: Trip maps use the CARTO Voyager basemap, with Latin-script labels worldwide.
integrations.carto_unset: Trip maps fall back to plain OpenStreetMap tiles, whose labels are in the local script.
integrations.aviationstack_set: Aircraft types and live flight status are looked up automatically.
integrations.aviationstack_unset: No aircraft types and no live flight status. Everything else about a flight still works.
integrations.photon_public_instance: Using komoot's public instance. Station and accommodation search work, but every place you type is sent to a shared, rate-limited service. Self-host Photon to avoid that.
integrations.photon_self_hosted: Using your own Photon instance for station and accommodation search.
integrations.photon_disabled: No station or accommodation search. Places save as plain text — no map pin, no timezone conversion, and they will not count toward visited countries.
integrations.ollama_set: Emails from unrecognised airlines are passed to the LLM as a last resort.
integrations.ollama_unset: Emails from unrecognised airlines are not parsed. All built-in airline rules still apply.
integrations.push_set: Push notifications are ready to send.
integrations.push_unset: No push notifications. Generate a key pair in the Push notifications section above.
